correctness.rationale: Every reflexive transitive antisymmetric relation yields a normal additive extensive idempotent unary possibility operation. Both operators commute iff their composites agree on singleton generators. The displayed four-world pair satisfies this exactly and its sixteen explicit unary words reach every mask. The code tests every off-diagonal relation pattern, filters precisely the partial-order axioms, checks commutation on every set, and closes every possible seed under three unary operations without a depth cutoff. The exhaustive count is 960 maximal labelled triples. Any automorphism of a maximal triple must fix each singleton and is the identity, giving 960/24 = 40 isomorphism classes. The 2^n cardinality ceiling proves minimal four-world size for more than fourteen sets. The code also checks necessary relation incomparability, seed-size distribution and least combined strict-edge count 4.

value.rationale: This is a sharp natural logical expressivity threshold, measuring the orbit of a single propositional valuation under unary negation and two commuting S4 modal operators. Unlike generic finite-table recomputation, the calculation completely counts and classifies the minimal models that attain the strongest possible expressivity, proves their rigidity, and reveals a necessary incomparability obstruction for the two relations. The exact 40-class invariant and four-world witness offer a small structural calibration for the distinction between a single Kuratowski modality and a commuting multimodal language.
